assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded I34.0
Unspecified cardiac arrhythmia is coded I49.9
The clinical events must be correlated with underlying rhythm disturbances
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of collapse
The payer's denial under PR-204 is contradicted by the documented need to correlate clinical events with underlying rhythm disturbances
The long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is represented by CPT 93247
